title: 第1章 发钱系统，当场暴富
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
砰！

    房门被一脚粗暴地踹开，剧烈的声响将陆舟猛地惊醒。

    他的心脏瞬间漏了半拍，浑身一个激灵，茫然睁开双眼……

    脑海里，大运迎面驶来的画面还在不停闪回。

    下一秒身体便被蛮横拽起……

    “云王，接旨吧！”

    话音未落，一名披甲的高大男子抬手将其从床上扔到了地上，双膝磕地！

    嘶……

    钻心的疼痛让陆舟清醒了几分，但神情依旧茫然。

    “奉天承运，武皇诏曰：废太子陆舟，心怀不轨，妄图勾结逆党，谋逆犯上……”

    宣旨的太监扬声开口，中气十足。

    陆舟却一个字都没听进去，脑海里满是杂乱的记忆画面……

    重生了？！

    随着记忆慢慢理顺，他的心陡然一沉。

    自己确实重生了，甚至还成了大周武朝的太子。

    只不过，前些日子刚被废，现在正要走马上任南方最贫瘠的云州，当一个闲散王爷……

    若只是如此，倒也还好。

    但陆舟清楚知道，所谓谋反，不过是自己那位亲弟弟陆哲特意伪造的。

    其目的，就是抢夺太子之位！

    此番赴任，生死难料！

    对方绝对不会允许自己这个废太子还活着，影响其后续的谋划。

    更何况，武皇早就对他这长子漠不关心，多次动了废立之心。

    就算他死在了赴任的路上，也不会掀起太多波浪。

    前身正因深知这一点，这才郁结而亡。

    最是无情帝王家！

    陆舟只觉一阵深深的无奈。

    【叮！系统加载中……】

    忽然，一道清脆电子提示音轰然响起。

    陆舟瞳孔一缩，原本郁闷的心情，荡然无存。

    统子哥来了？！

    穿越者的福利，果然少不了自己！

    还真是柳暗花明！

    他内心又惊又喜，心生期待……

    【领地人口发钱系统已加载完成。】
content_en:
Bang!

    The door was violently kicked open, and the violent sound suddenly woke Lu Zhou up.

    His heart skipped a beat for a moment, his whole body trembled, and he opened his eyes blankly...

    In my mind, the scene of the approaching Universiade is still flashing back.

    The next second his body was violently pulled up...

    "King Yun, take the order!"

    Before he finished speaking, a tall man in armor raised his hand and threw him from the bed to the ground, knocking his knees to the ground!

    Hiss...

    The excruciating pain made Lu Zhou sober up, but his expression was still dazed.

    "By God's will, Emperor Wu issued an edict: The deposed prince Lu Zhou has evil intentions, attempts to collude with the party, and commits treason..."

    The eunuch who announced the decree raised his voice and spoke with great energy.

    Lu Zhou didn't listen to a word, his mind was filled with messy memories...

    Reborn? !

    As the memory was slowly sorted out, his heart suddenly sank.

    He was indeed reborn, and even became the prince of the Wu Dynasty of Great Zhou Dynasty.

    However, he was just deposed a few days ago, and now he is about to take office in Yunzhou, the poorest place in the south, as an idle prince...

    If that was all, that would be okay.

    But Lu Zhou knew clearly that the so-called rebellion was just a fabrication deliberately made by his brother Lu Zhe.

    Its purpose is to seize the crown prince's position!

    When I take office this time, life or death is unpredictable!

    The other party will never allow himself, the deposed prince, to be alive and affect his subsequent plans.

    What's more, Emperor Wu had long been indifferent to his eldest son, and had repeatedly considered abolishing him.

    Even if he died on the way to his appointment, it would not cause too many waves.

    It was precisely because his predecessor knew this that he became depressed and died.

    The most ruthless emperor's family!

    Lu Zhou felt a deep helplessness.

    【bite! The system is loading...]

    Suddenly, a crisp electronic beep sounded loudly.

    Lu Zhou's pupils shrank, and his original depressed mood disappeared.

    Brother Tongzi is here? !

    The welfare of the time traveler is indeed indispensable to himself!

    It's really a bright future!

    He was surprised, happy, and looking forward to it...

    [The territorial population payment system has been loaded. 】
